subject: refactor(material/datepicker): switch tests to standalone
reviewer: Codex primary implementer; independent audit remains separate

hunk_reviews.judgment: Adds direct MatFormField/MatLabel imports beside the retained module import for private standalone date-range fixtures. No product import or consumer scope changes.

Removes the private createComponent declarations parameter. The normalized remaining signature/body preserves providers and TestBed creation; the owned shared legacy helper retains its own modules/declarations API.
Moves the fixture into TestBed imports and removes its declarations array. This is a modern standalone test-environment change, not a change to date-range behavior or retained legacy declarations.
Removes the empty declarations argument from the RTL fixture call, preserving its Directionality provider object and assertions.
Marks StandardRangePicker standalone and adds its exact seven directive/form imports. Its entire template and executable class body remain unchanged.
Marks RangePickerNoStart standalone with its exact five date-range/form-field imports; preserves its intentionally malformed fixture and assertion.
Marks RangePickerNoEnd standalone with the same exact five imports; preserves this separate malformed fixture and assertion.
Marks RangePickerNgModel standalone with its exact six imports including FormsModule; preserves model bindings and assertions.
Marks RangePickerNoLabel standalone with five exact imports; preserves the unlabeled fixture and existing behavior checks.
Marks the private CustomValidator directive standalone without adding imports; preserves its validator provider and implementation.
Marks RangePickerWithCustomValidator standalone with seven exact imports including CustomValidator/FormsModule. The validator and template bytes are unchanged.
Marks RangePickerErrorStateMatcher standalone with five exact imports; preserves its matcher fixture and assertions.
Expands public datepicker imports for the private standalone date-range harness. No owned public datepicker implementation is introduced.
Replaces the private DateRangeInputHarnessTest module import with its exact six native/date-range/form imports. The template, cases and harness operations stay exact.
Changes the modern form-field harness imports from aggregate modules to public standalone components/directives. The owned MatLegacy module configuration remains distinct and reachable.
Simplifies modern root TestBed imports while keeping native-date, fixture and datepicker module provisioning. No legacy TestBed declaration is removed.
Expands modern FormFieldHarnessTest imports to the exact eighteen native/form/control/date directive bindings. All template bytes and assertions remain intact; retain the owned legacy fixture.

decision: Review all17 hunks across the complete date-range-input, date-range harness and form-field harness files. They migrate private fixture declarations/import scopes to standalone components/directives, add explicit per-fixture imports, simplify the createComponent declarations parameter and its RTL provider call, and move public Material imports. Every fixture template, assertion and other operation is preserved after only those exact setup normalizations, and the ten explicit resulting fixture scopes are checked independently. The owned legacy harness is reachable: it uses MatLegacy modules, a shared FormFieldHarnessTest TestBed declaration, current public datepicker harnesses and a stable public native-date module. Preserve this non-standalone historical module setup, exact templates/selectors and case roster; do not transplant modern standalone component contracts. Decline the private fixture migration. Actual harness compilation, mixed legacy/current behavior and floors remain pending.
